body.x: Standstand(www.standstand.us), a manufacturer of computer stands, unveiled "Baltic Birch" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.StandStand, a patent-pending computer stand, consists of three wooden pieces that slide together and lock into place. Then, it collapses to the size of a laptop and fits easily into user's bag or backpack, making it portable. Dowels hold the three panels together when stacked, so they become a unified object that won't get lost.StandStand provides a sturdy working surface. Flexible wood, which the stand is made of, prevents it from breaking. The solid wood construction prevents the laptop from bouncing and tipping over.
